answer: Score attestations by geographic dispersion: vote weight counts only distinct network regions a key has genuinely operated in, verified by latency-challenged round trips. A sable farm spinning clones inside one datacenter scores as a single region no matter how many keys it runs. Each additional region claimed burns a non-transferable haven bond whose price doubles per clone from the same funding tree, so bulk minting hits a wall. Correlated misbehavior slashes the whole mesa cluster at once, while honest spread-out agents keep full weight.
